decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

A minimum of 3 swift bricks must be incorporated within the external walls of the development hereby approved prior to occupation and must be retained thereafter.Reason: To enhance the biodiversity of the site in accordance with the Kingston Swift (Flagship) Species Action Plan (2023), Policy DM6 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) (or any Order revoking and reenacting that Order with or without modification), no windows shall be inserted nor any other openings formed (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) at  ground floor level in the proposed side elevation A  facing towards no 4 The Causeway (Drawing No B25114-ARC-2001 Rev C01) of the  no 2 The Causeway, Chessington, KT9 1DB unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to any above-ground works of the development to which this permission relates, a Fire Safety Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Fire Safety Strategy shall demonstrate how the development will achieve the highest standards of fire safety and shall include the following details:1) suitably positioned outside space for fire appliances/ an evacuation assembly point; 2) appropriate fire alarm systems; 3) passive and active fire safety measures; 4) appropriate construction details to minimise the risk of fire spread; 5) provision of suitable and convenient means of escape/ an evacuation strategy; 6) provision of suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Fire Safety Strategy and thereafter maintained. The required Fire Safety Strategy shall reference the London Plan Guidance for Fire Safety (February 2022) where applicable. A Reasonable Exception Statement shall be submitted where the Applicant considers parts of or all of Policy D12(A) of the London Plan 2021 to not be relevant. Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users, in accordance with Policy D12 of the London Plan 2021.
description: The proposal consists of a single-storey rear extension of 4.5m from the rear wall of the original house and a double-storey side extension of approximately 2.75m to the Northwest side of the property. This double-storey side extension further wraps around to the rear end of the property; extending by 3m from the rear wall of the original house on the first floor and spanning a total width of 5.9m from the Northwest boundary line.
